Kia Sorento Launched in India: Price, Variants, and Specifications Overview

03 Nov 2026, 02:29 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: www.autocarindia.com

2 min read

Key takeawaysNote: Final on-road prices depend on local dealership fees and insurance choices. Buyers should verify official ex-showroom details directly with authorized local dealers.

In this article
  1. Overview and Market Launch
  2. Pricing and Variant Structure
  3. Powertrain, Transmission, and Performance
  4. Practical Implications and Verification

Overview and Market Launch

The Kia Sorento has entered the Indian automotive market, offering a comprehensive lineup comprising 32 variants designed to cater to diverse consumer preferences across fuel types and configurations. As a premium three-row SUV, the Sorento aims to capture market share in the competitive mid-to-high-end utility vehicle segment by combining comfort, advanced technology, and multiple powertrain options.

Pricing and Variant Structure

Pricing for the Kia Sorento varies significantly across its extensive lineup due to regional taxes, RTO registration, and insurance.

  • Base Variant: The entry-level Diesel HTE DCT 7 Seat is priced at an ex-showroom starting rate of Rs. 27.99 lakh in Sangrur, translating to an estimated on-road price of Rs. 33.45 lakh inclusive of statutory charges. Financing this base trim involves an estimated monthly EMI of Rs. 48,428 against a loan amount of Rs. 30,10,000.
  • Top-End Variant: The range-topping Hybrid Turbo GDI HTX(A) Black Line AT AWD 6 Seat features all-wheel drive and is priced at an estimated on-road figure of Rs. 48.27 lakh.

*Note: Final on-road prices depend on local dealership fees and insurance choices. Buyers should verify official ex-showroom details directly with authorized local dealers.*

Powertrain, Transmission, and Performance

The Sorento lineup is structured exclusively around automatic transmissions, omitting manual gearboxes entirely. Engine and powertrain choices include:

  • Diesel Engine: Paired with an automatic transmission, well-suited for long-distance highway cruising and strong mid-range torque delivery.
  • Strong-Hybrid Petrol: Combines a petrol engine with hybrid assistance, targeted at buyers seeking enhanced efficiency and refined city drivability.
  • All-Wheel Drive (AWD): Available on select higher-tier trims like the Black Line AWD versions.

*Mileage or fuel economy figures have not been published with standardized test cycle certifications (such as ARAI or WLTP) in the announcement text; consumers are advised to rely on independent real-world tests for precise consumption data.* Safety equipment varies by trim, with high-end variants incorporating comprehensive features, including a Level 2+ ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance Systems) suite.

Practical Implications and Verification

When considering the Kia Sorento, prospective buyers must evaluate whether higher trims justify their steep price premiums over the base model. To verify current pricing, promotional offers, and exact availability, customers should visit authorized dealerships—such as the regional touchpoint located at Khasra No. 171, Mehlan - Delhi Road, Sangrur, Punjab 148001—or download the official brochure from Kia's verified channels.
